== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Heaven’s Drops{{!}}Heaven's Drops are powerful [[constructs]] that can be used to facilitate significant spiritual [[advancement]]. In their natural state, they appear as dull, colorless, or gray-green objects. To function correctly, they must be activated using a [[soul-strengthening elixir]]; the effectiveness of this process is determined by the quality of the liquid used. Depending on the catalyst, a Heaven's Drop can provide a minor boost or trigger a permanent transformation that fundamentally alters an individual's soul. When properly catalyzed, these [[constructs]] can glow with intense light and emit energy such as lightning. Once consumed or integrated, they can nourish a user's channels and cores, fill them with power, and push specific cores to their maximum capacity. They have also been used to help individuals reach the limits of stages like [[Truegold]].}}
